newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-SCOTLAND DROP ARMSTRONG AND CHALMERS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SCOTLAND DROP ARMSTRONG AND CHALMERS.

text.p: Scotland have dropped half-backs Craig Chalmers and Gary Armstrong as well as centre Scott Hastings from their team to meet England in the Calcutta Cup at Twickenham on February 1.
Greg Townsend moves from centre to fly-half where he will partner Bryan Redpath who is recalled in place of Armstrong.
Winger Tony Stanger will partner Ron Ericksson at centre with Derek Stark taking over on the right wing.
Tom Smith replaces David Hilton at prop and Ian Smith comes in at open-side flanker in place of Murray Wallace.
Scotland lost 34-19 to Wales in their opening Five Nations' championship match last Saturday.

Scotland - Rowen Shepherd; Derek Stark, Tony Stanger, Ron Ericksson, Kenny Logan; Gregor Townsend, Bryan Redpath; Rob Wainwright (captain), Ian Smith, Peter Walton, Doddie Weir, Andy Reed, Mattie Stewart, Graham Ellis, Tom Smith.
